name: vericraft
description: VeriCraft: Transparent Supply Chain Proof of Origin for Artisan Goods

scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const mime={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.js':'application/javascript; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.jpeg':'image/jpeg','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{const cleanUrl=req.url.split('?')[0];const relPath=cleanUrl==='/'?'index.html':cleanUrl.replace(/^\//,'');const filePath=path.join(__dirname,'frontend',relPath);if(!filePath.startsWith(path.join(__dirname,'frontend'))){res.writeHead(403);res.end('Forbidden');return;}fs.readFile(filePath,(err,data)=>{if(err){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found');return;}res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime[path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase()]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(data);});}).listen(3000,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('VeriCraft frontend running at http://localhost:3000'));"
scripts.lint: node --check hardhat.config.js && node --check scripts/deploy.js && node --check frontend/app.js
